data.narrative:
Critical Loop, a Series A climate and energy company founded by Bala Ramamurthy, has raised $49M to date. The relevant comp universe comprises one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Given the company's stage and capital raised, stage-progression methodology is applicable. Using total raised ($49M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Series A-to-next-stage multiplier of 2.0x yields an implied valuation of $98M. Peer-median analysis was not executable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy peer set; although eight sector peers exist, zero meet filtering criteria for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier. Peer-median analysis would require a minimum of three datapoints to be reliable and fell short.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $83M to $113M, with a median of $98M. This range reflects stage-typical progression mechanics applied to documented capital. Key uncertainties include the absence of tightly comparable Series A peers at equivalent scale, which limits triangulation to a single method. Any valuation within this band depends substantially on Critical Loop's path to Series B milestones—capital efficiency, technology validation, and market traction remain unspecified in available data and warrant detailed diligence before commitment.
